design.link_tiers: primary = Law (2011) determinations by a named instrumental method only; sensitivity = Law Chapter 4 reference-based assignments, separately labelled, never pooled, carries no verdict (adopted 2B)
design.meluhha: contributes no site-pair links under any posture (catalogue_only; its 76 citations name a region, never an Indus site)
design.arms: ceramic and bead/craft, each computed on its own eligible site set, never pooled (adopted 3A)
design.estimand: MRM/MRQAP (double semi-partialling) partial R^2 of the binary shared-source indicator net of geographic distance, river-network distance, pair sample size, and publication intensity
design.controls: R = 199 synthetic replicates of the identical pipeline per arm; negative control PASS iff the SUPPORTED rule fires in <= 5% of replicates; positive control (planted partial R^2 ~ 0.04) PASS iff >= 95%; a non-discriminating control makes the run INVALID
design.ceramic_arm: conditionally estimable (DD-7): closes NOT ESTIMABLE at the execution margins step if sources at audited postures cannot evidence >= 8 eligible ceramic sites; no ceramic response is computed in that case
declared_untestable: dose-response as a verdict-bearing test (labelled sensitivity only)
design.execution_gate: OSF registration of this frozen contract before any execution (adopted 6A); execution itself is not ordered by this freeze
